newsitem.title: USA: Whitman Pepsi Bottler 1996 profit rises.
newsitem.headline: Whitman Pepsi Bottler 1996 profit rises.

text.p: Whitman Corp said Thursday its Pepsi-Cola General Bottlers unit had a record operating profit of $212.3 million in 1996, up from the previous record of $197.7 million in 1995.
Pepsi General earned $46.8 million in the fourth quarter, up from $41.4 million a year ago.
In Poland, Pepsi General's sales rose more than 44 percent to $50 million for 1996. Operating losses were $12.1 million compared with $11.3 million in 1995.
Domestically, Pepsi General's operating profit was up 7.4 percent for the year.
Pepsi General's sales totaled $1.50 billion in 1996, up from $1.45 million a year ago. Fourth quarter sales were $357.7 million, up from $365.0 million.
Case volume in the United States increased nearly four percent for the year.

Whitman said its Midas International unit's operating profit for the year dropped to $78.0 million from $82.5 million, due to slow domestic retail and wholesale activity and increased operating expenses. For the quarter, Midas' operating profit dropped to $12.8 million from $15.7 million.
Midas sales were $604.2 million for the year, up from $576.1 million, and $143.2 million for the quarter, up from $134.3 million a year ago.
Whitman said its Hussmann Corp unit's operating profit was $93.8 million for the year, up from $78.7 million a year ago,and $33.6 million for the quarter, up from $29.0 million.
Sales for Hussman topped $1.0 billion for the first time, rising more than nine percent to just over $1.0 billion from $921.7 million in 1995.
Sales for the quarter were $323.6 million, up from $291.0 million.
